name: Notes
description: Notes for each project that you write and Claude reads. Edit them in the sidebar or in a tab, and Claude reads them and adds sections with notes__read and notes__write.

mcpTools.name: read
mcpTools.description: Returns the notes the user keeps for a project. Read them at the start of a task: they hold context, decisions and rules the user wants followed. `project` is an absolute path inside the project; leave it out to use the project this terminal belongs to. Read-only.

project.description: An absolute path to the project folder, or a folder inside it. Defaults to this terminal's project.

mcpTools.name: write
mcpTools.description: Adds a timestamped section with your text to the end of a project's notes. It never changes or removes what is there. Use it for decisions, findings and follow-ups worth keeping for the next session, not for a log of what you did. `project` is an absolute path inside the project; leave it out to use the project this terminal belongs to.

project.description: An absolute path to the project folder, or a folder inside it. Defaults to this terminal's project.
